wiki.title: Bill Ward (North Carolina politician)
wiki.extract: Bill Ward (born 1950 or 1951) is an American politician who serves as a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing the 5th district (including all of Hertford, Gates, Pasquotank, and Camden counties) since 2023.
